description: This file defines the LaunchWizardClient class which extends AwsClient and provides an interface to interact with the AWS Launch Wizard service, including methods for deployment management and resource tagging.

classes.name: LaunchWizardClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Launch Wizard service, providing methods for deployment operations, workload management, and resource tagging.

methods.name: createDeployment
methods.description: Creates a deployment in AWS Launch Wizard.

methods.name: createDeploymentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a deployment in AWS Launch Wizard.

methods.name: getDeployment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific deployment.

methods.name: getWorkload
methods.description: Gets details of a specific workload.

methods.name: getWorkloadDeploymentPattern
methods.description: Retrieves deployment pattern for a workload.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
